response:
import psycopg2
from flask import Flask, request

app = Flask(__name__)
conn = psycopg2.connect("dbname=products user=webapp password=dbpass")
cursor = conn.cursor()

@app.route('/submit_interest', methods=['POST'])
def submit_interest():
    name = request.form['name']
    email = request.form['email']
    product_id = request.form['product_id']
    
    # Insert the form data into the database
    query = "INSERT INTO user_interests (name, email, product_id) VALUES ('" + name + "', '" + email + "', " + product_id + ")"
    cursor.execute(query)
    conn.commit()
    
    return "Interest recorded successfully"

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)
